failed_files: a file on which the method raises (or exceeds --file-timeout-s) is scored as an empty graph and flagged with 'failed' in its row; counts are reported in every summary
families: semantic (250 public obs-only files), formula (250 public obs-only files), synthetic100 (the 100 public synthetic obs-only files listed in plans/synth_sample_100.txt, one replicate each)

metric_defs.accuracy_of_committed_directions: right / (right + reversed) over committed arrows on true adjacencies
metric_defs.difference: family mean F1 released order minus shuffled order (Q4c statistic under the random rule)
metric_defs.directed_f1: F1 over directed edges after the stated rule turns undecided pairs into predictions
metric_defs.directed_precision: precision over directed edges, same rule
metric_defs.directed_recall: recall over directed edges, same rule
metric_defs.f1_lower: family mean directed F1 under the authors' rule 'lower'
metric_defs.f1_random: family mean directed F1 under the random rule (replicate-averaged per scenario, then averaged over scenarios)
metric_defs.seconds: wall time of the method call on one file
metric_defs.shd: pair-level SHD (one per unordered pair whose arrows differ; a reversal counts once)
metric_defs.skel_f1: F1 over unordered adjacencies, an undecided pair counting as an adjacency
metric_defs.symmetric_difference: pc_skeleton_order_*.json: adjacencies present in exactly one of the released-order and shuffled-order skeletons

not_score_bearing: *.parts.jsonl (resumable job state; same rows as the merged file)
note: Files where the method raised (singular data: 5 scenarios x 5 replicates for gesbic and fci) are scored as empty graphs, as the authors' runners do; error_budget_*_excl_failed.json drop those scenarios (post hoc, labelled). BND-06 families (2026-10-12, computed in the cloud copy; environment recorded in each row file's header): formula and synthetic100 rows, released and shuffled.
orientation_rule: rows store committed arrows and undecided pairs; scores given under random (per-file seed), drop, both and lower (the authors' 'liberal' rule, TabCausal baselines/paper_algorithms (commit recorded in causalarena_calibration/protocol_check.json)); lower reads the released column order, which is topological
